answer: Trust starts at a jetty of 50 audited seed agents. Each epoch, zephyr walks of 20 random steps leave the jetty along payment edges, and an agent's vote weight is capped at the trust its walks deliver. Sybils link to honest agents through few edges: 10,000 fakes behind 10 links collect about what 10 honest agents get, 1/1,000 of their headcount weight. Weakness: fakes befriend newcomers to farm edges. Fix: an edge counts only after 5 epochs of jade receipts, settlements moving value both ways.
